query: For a high-entropy alloy designed as a single-phase solid solution and exhibiting a favorable strength–ductility combination, what single testable hypothesis proposes an intervention to preserve toughness after thermal exposure and subsequent loading? Explain the hypothesized mechanism, predict the outcome relative to the same alloy tested under identical conditions without the intervention, define the applicable exposure and loading regime, identify supporting evidence from prior observations, and specify an experiment whose result would falsify the hypothesis.

generation.hypothesis: The introduction of a specific grain refinement treatment prior to thermal exposure can preserve toughness in a high-entropy alloy after subsequent loading.
generation.material_initial_state: Single-phase solid solution high-entropy alloy with a favorable strength–ductility combination
generation.conditions: Thermal exposure followed by mechanical loading
generation.mechanism: The refined grain structure reduces the formation of detrimental precipitates and increases the density of grain boundaries, which act as obstacles to dislocation movement, thereby preserving toughness.
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved toughness compared to the same alloy without the grain refinement treatment, tested under identical conditions
generation.baseline: Toughness of the alloy without grain refinement treatment
generation.boundary: Thermal exposure temperature below 800°C and loading stress below the yield strength of the alloy
generation.uncertainty: The effectiveness of the grain refinement treatment may depend on the specific composition of the high-entropy alloy and the details of the thermal exposure and loading regime

falsification_experiment.design: Compare the toughness of the high-entropy alloy with and without the grain refinement treatment after thermal exposure and loading
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the toughness of the alloy with the grain refinement treatment is not significantly higher than that of the alloy without the treatment, the hypothesis is falsified
